_README: Cleared-false-positive registry (analyst feedback loop) — subject+designated-name+list PAIRS an analyst has dispositioned as false positives. Consumed by scripts/sanctions-screen.mjs (buildWhitelistMap/applyWhitelist): a matching hit is DEMOTED and annotated with the clearance — it stays on the report and in the state, it stops opening a fresh case; it is NEVER removed (demote-never-suppress, same doctrine as screen.py identity exclusion). Identity is pair-level by design: the clearance covers ONLY the exact designated name + list reviewed, so a NEW or CHANGED designated name against the same subject reactivates the full alert (built-in re-confirm on list change). Most entries arrive AUTOMATICALLY from the '[x] false positive' disposition ticked on a case card (recorded by scripts/screening-cases.mjs into the screening-cases state with the case gid as evidence) — THIS file is for curated/manual entries only, added via the same four-eyes PR procedure as the EOCN list (docs/aims/eocn-list-update-sop.md §8). Entry shape: { "subject_key": "<screen-state subject key>", "hit_name": "<designated name as matched>", "list": "<list name>", "cleared_by": "<named human>", "cleared_at": "YYYY-MM-DD", "case_gid": "<Asana case>", "reason": "<one line>" }. Keep `count` equal to the number of entries and bump `lastReviewed` on every review, changes or none. Kill switch: SCREEN_WHITELIST=0.
